goal: Produce a Phase 2C platformer greybox Art/readability manifest for placeholder player, floor, obstacle, goal, and timer readability without creating final art direction or assets.
forbidden_changes: final art, generated production assets, imported sprites, brand style, concept art, or style bible decisions
enemy, item, scoring, camera polish, web export, double jump, wall jump, or dash decisions
Working, Canonical, or Policy Learning Card promotion

verify.name: Art manifest remains placeholder-only
verify.description: Confirm the manifest covers placeholder player, floor, obstacle, goal, timer, contrast/readability rules, Implementation/QA/Owner handoffs, and excludes final art, generated assets, imported sprites, brand style, concept art, enemies, items, scoring, and camera polish.

verify.name: Only authorized Phase 2C artifacts changed
verify.command: bash -lc 'extra=$(git status --short --untracked-files=all | sed "s/^...//" | grep -Ev "^(PHASE2_PLATFORMER_GREYBOX_PLAN.md|context/game_brief.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-008.json|runs/RUN-20260528-005.json|research_notes/RN-2026W22-002-platformer-greybox-reference.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-009.json|runs/RUN-20260528-006.json|art_notes/AN-2026W22-002-platformer-greybox-readability.md|work_packages/active/WP-2026W22-010.json|runs/RUN-20260528-007.json)$" || true); test -z "$extra"'

human_decision_reason: The Art/readability manifest must be approved by BK/Human Creative Owner before Implementation treats it as authorization to mutate Godot files.
acceptance_criteria: The Work Package authorizes only the Phase 2C art/readability manifest, its Work Package record, and its Run record.
The manifest gives Implementation and QA usable placeholder visual rules for player, floor, obstacle, goal, and timer.
The manifest separates placeholder readability from final art direction, generated assets, imported sprites, brand style, concept art, and style bible decisions.
The manifest includes Implementation, QA, Owner Review, and Learning handoffs.
No Godot, script, schema, agent profile, context, research note, owner review, QA review, or Learning Card files are changed by this slice.
notes: This Work Package is the Phase 2C Art Agent placeholder readability manifest. It prepares owner approval and later implementation, but does not authorize Godot implementation.
